NewsArticle.Title: Journal
NewsArticle.Content: Save a special moment, an inspired spontaneous poem or story, a romantic moment, a wonderful event at the fair or elsewhere. Use your journal. Please be respectful and considerate with how you use the journal. Gain permission of others if quoting them. Respect the privacy of others, or you will quickly find yourself friendless and untrusted by all. Since a journal is an easily edited text file, do not believe a journal entry to be proof. The journal is only stored on your Dark Ages program folder. It is private and not available to anyone else unless you choose to make it available. Journal Instructions - View your Dark Ages conversation window. - Press j to turn on/off Journal. - The red words "Start recording/End recording" will appear in your conversation window. - All conversation before "Start recording" message is not recorded. - When you are done, exit Dark Ages. - Enter your Dark Ages program folder. - Enter your character's folder. - A text file will be there with your character's name and a long number, which is the month, day, hour, and minute that you began recording in.
